problem:
What is the value of $f(t)=\sqrt[3]{{t}^{2}+4}\,i+{3}^{t}\,j+\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{\pi t}{2})\,k$ at $t=2?$

$f(2)=$
{{field-1}} $i\,+\,$

{{field-2}} $j\,+\,$

{{field-3}} $k$
worked_solution:
To evaluate, we substitute $t=2$ into the function, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(2) & =\sqrt[3]{{2}^{2}+4}\,i+{3}^{2}\,j+\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{2\pi }{2})\,k \\  & =\sqrt[3]{8}\,i+{3}^{2}\,j+\operatorname{tan}⁡(\pi )\,k \\  & =2\,i+9\,j+0\,k\end{aligned}
$$
